items.role: Police officer; retired as captain overseeing the Financial and Property Crimes Bureau

citations.quote: Anthony began his career with Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department in 1980 and most recently served the community as a captain overseeing the Financial and Property Crimes Bureau of the department.

items.office: Member, Las Vegas City Council, Ward 4 (Mayor Pro Tem for seven years)

citations.quote: In 2009, Anthony was elected to the Las Vegas City Council, representing Ward 4, where he served three terms. He also served as Mayor Pro Tem for 7 of those years.

items.office: Regent, Nevada System of Higher Education Board of Regents (served as chairman)

citations.quote: Anthony was elected in 2002 to a four-year term as a regent with the Nevada System of Higher Education and served a second term. As chairman of the Board of Regents, Anthony led the way in developing a master plan, system goals and a value statement.
